shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：用立包加一片展开护翼的同框研究抢点击，替掉源首屏的卡通糖粉云台与精灵插画。
shots.textZone: top solid #1F3B4D headline bar plus three empty ruled rails low on the right

shots.intent: 承接源页第 2 屏的六格烦恼位：保留 3x2 格子结构，把症状句与灰图位改成空卡与空栏，让买家自行代入。
shots.textZone: top headline line plus one short blank rail under each of the six slots

shots.intent: 把源页第 3 屏的机理标注改造成可实拍的构造研究：只交代护翼、压纹与边缝本身，删掉所有功能层断言。

shots.intent: 承接源页第 5 屏的双图并列结构：改为左右同框同机位的两片对照，只留空栏不下结论。

shots.intent: 承接源页第 4 屏的 STEP1-3：只拍产品自身三步展开状态，删掉更换时长与身体护理建议，避免任何人体出镜。
shots.textZone: one line under the sequence plus one short blank rail per frame

shots.intent: 承接源页日夜组合的选款诉求：一行多件同框完成挑选，型号差异只由参考图自己承载，不写长度与片数。

shots.intent: 承接源页第 2 与第 6 屏的参数卡：格位全空、印章框留白，用可实拍的正面反面侧边三视图承担信任而不出示任何证书。
shots.textZone: one section line above the card plus twelve empty ruled cells read as bracketed label slots

shots.intent: 收口：暗版场把整组收在一条主张与一个空动作位上，不用促销、时长建议与统计元素逼单。

style.backgroundSystem: two alternating printed-paper fields only: a matte cotton-rag paper field #F6F8F5 ruled with a hairline #DCE5EA grid and carrying one dashed #2E7FA6 die-cut outline of the product silhouette, and a card-stock plane #DCE5EA used for comparison, variant and card screens; dark closing screens use a plain #1F3B4D panel with one hairline #2E7FA6 rule. Never a photographed room, never a bathroom, never a bed, never a candy-pink gradient field, never clouds, petals or sparkles.
style.direction: quiet drafting-paper commerce for feminine care
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline #2E7FA6 drafting pictograms only: dashed die-cut outlines of the product shape, corner tick crosses, leader lines ending in a small square terminal, empty square frames and empty outlined discs used as unlabeled step marks; no filled badges, no certification seals, no shield or leaf motifs, no gradient icons, no 3D pictograms, no numerals inside any disc.
style.lightingSystem: one low raking key near 6000K entering from the right about 30 degrees above the paper, so every object throws one long soft shadow to the left; a weak cool bounce from the left only, never a front fill; macro and edge screens swap the key for one narrow hard grazing band from the right that gives each peeled step its own thin highlight; dark closing screens use one narrow side sweep from the right. Contact shadows are always believable and the product never floats.
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent quiet drafting-paper visual system for feminine-care e-commerce across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte cotton-rag paper field #F6F8F5, card-stock plane #DCE5EA, deep drafting-ink panel #1F3B4D and one hairline ruling-blue accent #2E7FA6; cool 6000K treatment; one narrow condensed grotesque family with a single tight-tracking headline line plus one hairline latin rail, Chinese copy always inside 「」 brackets only; background system limited to the two printed-paper fields and the plain #1F3B4D panel, one dashed #2E7FA6 die-cut product outline as the only graphic motif, never a photographed room, never a candy-pink gradient, never clouds or petals; lighting system of one low raking key from the right at about 30 degrees above the paper so every shadow runs long to the left, a weak cool bounce from the left, narrow hard grazing light only on edge and macro screens, always a believable contact shadow and never a floating product; surfaces limited to matte paper, card stock and one plain dark board, no marble, wood, tile, towel weave, liquid or wet reflection; icon system of single-weight hairline #2E7FA6 drafting marks: dashed die-cut outlines, corner tick crosses, leader lines with small square terminals, empty square frames and empty unlabeled discs, no filled badges and no certification seals; the pad keeps its reference outline, wing form, surface quilting, dashed side seams, back-sheet pattern and colourway, the pack keeps its own silhouette and printed placement with no invented legible lettering; product is always a clean pack-and-pad study on paper, never on or beside a body, never on underwear, no people at all; every claim slot, grid cell and seal frame stays empty; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent light direction, no mismatched icon styles, no medical or antibacterial claim, no hypoallergenic or gynaecologist-tested wording, no material composition, no absorbency figure, no pad count, no millimetre size, no registration or certification mark, no price or QR code.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #F6F8F5, #DCE5EA, #1F3B4D and #2E7FA6
no candy-pink gradient field, no cloud bed, no scattered petals, no cartoon fairy mascot
no medical, therapeutic, treatment or prevention wording of any kind
no antibacterial, germ-kill, antimicrobial, anti-odour or hygiene-protection assertion
no hypoallergenic, skin-safe, doctor-recommended or gynaecologist-tested assertion
no material or ingredient composition, no fibre or layer naming, no percentages
no absorbency volume, no absorption-speed figure, no pad count, no length in millimetres, no size numerals
no registration number, disinfection/health licence code, execution-standard code, certification, lab report, test seal or stamp
no price, discount, coupon, shipping promise, membership corner badge, QR code, shop or platform wording
no depiction of menstruation, no fluid of any kind, no stain on product, paper, card or garment, no calendar period-day marking
no product shown on or against a body, no underwear, no face, no identifiable person, no hands
no mixed fonts, no random photographic backgrounds, no change of light direction between shots
style.presentationRules: the pad keeps the reference outline, wing form, surface quilting, dashed side seams, back-sheet pattern and colourway exactly; the pack keeps its own silhouette, gusset and printed placement with no invented legible lettering; products are photographed as clean pack-and-pad studies on the paper field, never worn, held, placed on or beside a body, garment or underwear; human presence is not used at all; every proof slot, seal frame and grid cell stays an empty rail; vertical edges of the pack stay strictly vertical.
style.surfaceSystem: matte cotton-rag paper field #F6F8F5, card-stock plane #DCE5EA, one plain #1F3B4D board. No marble, no wood, no tile, no linen or towel weave, no milk or liquid surface, no water mirror, no wet reflection, no floor.
style.typography: one narrow condensed grotesque family; a single tight-tracking headline line set either bare in #1F3B4D or inside a solid #1F3B4D bar, with one hairline #2E7FA6 latin rail beneath it; short ruled label rails only, no dense body paragraphs, no outlined bubble lettering, no rounded cartoon type, no handwritten script.
